objective: Implement a persistent VPS supervisor that continuously backtests and researches every current V11 catalog symbol independently until each symbol has genuinely proven >=80.00% WR under the approved 4-month protocol, with RR exactly 1:1 or 1:2 and no more than 3 valid entries per eligible day. It must preserve anti-overfit/OOS integrity, resume after restart, use bounded 5-AI proposals for stalled symbols, and never unlock Telegram or execute trades.
acceptance_criteria: Implement v11-backtest-supervisor as a systemd-managed VPS service without breaking v11-manual-ai-bridge.
Track every current catalog symbol independently with persistent atomic state and restart-resume behavior.
Use the latest ~122-day M5 evidence and at most 3 valid entries per eligible day; Crypto all calendar days, Forex/Metal/Index no Saturday/Sunday.
RR is exactly 1:1 or 1:2; next-bar entry, adverse cost padding, same-bar TP+SL=>SL, timeout=>non-win.
Local search happens before paid AI calls. Failed/stalled symbols may request bounded proposals from all five bridge providers.
AI proposals are advisory/config-bounded only and cannot lower threshold, remove symbols, disable OOS, change execution authority, or unlock Telegram.
Do not repeatedly tune against the same final OOS. Freeze candidate before final OOS; failed OOS cannot be used as direct parameter-ranking feedback in the same generation.
Expose localhost-only health on 127.0.0.1:8791 with passCount/totalSymbols, queue counts, blocked/research states, current SHA and last result timestamp; no secrets.
Default concurrency is bounded and configurable; prevent duplicate service instances and runaway AI spend.
Global success is true only when every catalog symbol independently proves >=80.00% and all integrity gates pass.
Signal V11 Telegram remains maintenance locked throughout implementation and validation.
